name: Culture Cellar
description: Grow a live culture in the cool, then harvest it with heat and Acid.

residues.name: Seasoned Crock
residues.text: Each harvest spending at least 4 Culture returns 1 / 2 Culture. Smaller harvests do not refill it.

residues.name: Sugar Glaze
residues.text: Every valid growth gains 1 / 2 extra Culture. A full-six harvest scores ×1.5 / ×2.

objective.text: Harvest all 6 Culture in one bowl.

residues.name: Living Lid
residues.text: With at least 3 banked Culture, Preservation bonus points gain ×1.5 / ×2.25. Grow cool, then let the bank season your next bowl.

objective.text: Grow 8 Culture while this residue is installed.

residues.name: The Last Drop
residues.text: A harvest with at least 2.5 effective Acid scores ×1.4 / ×1.8. Multiplies Sugar Glaze when both conditions hold.

objective.text: Twice harvest at least 4 Culture with 2.5+ effective Acid.

cards.name: Mother Culture
cards.text: At 40–60°C, with at least 1 effective Sugar, the oldest live Culture source grows 1 Culture per serving (cap 6). Bubble Fig adds 1; Sugar Glaze adds its tier every growth. Build the bank, then harvest with Acid at 90°C+.

cards.name: Wild Yeast
cards.text: A second Culture source: at 40–60°C and effective Sugar ≥1, it grows a base 1 Culture only if it is the oldest live source. Multiple sources do not stack; Bubble Fig or Sugar Glaze can boost growth before a 90°C+ Acid harvest.

cards.name: Orchard Peel
cards.text: Sugar 2 can feed Culture growth at 40–60°C. Acid 1 can harvest it at 90°C+, but this card loses base heat value as the pot gets hotter. Its Sugar also pairs with Protein for Browning or Acid for Preservation.

cards.name: Sour Plum
cards.text: Sugar 1 feeds Culture at 40–60°C; Acid 2 harvests at 90°C+. Harvest strength uses at most 3 effective Acid. Spending 4+ Culture activates Seasoned Crock; spending all 6 activates Sugar Glaze’s large harvest multiplier.

cards.name: Candycap
cards.text: Sugar 2 feeds cool Culture growth; Aromatic pairs with Fat for Infusion at 40–100°C. Candycap has no Acid, so it cannot trigger a Culture harvest on its own.

cards.name: Cool Cream
cards.text: At 40–60°C, the oldest live Culture source retains at least 96% after serving, allowing it to survive a long setup. Fat 1 also pairs with Aromatic for Infusion at 40–100°C; protection stops outside the cool band.

cards.name: Ember Root
cards.text: High immediate score at 90–110°C helps when there is no time to build Culture. Its Sugar 1 can still feed growth at 40–60°C, but its own base score is poor at cool heat.

cards.name: Bubble Fig
cards.text: At 40–60°C, if a live Culture source and Sugar ≥1 already allow growth, Bubble Fig adds 1 extra Culture (maximum 6). Copies do not stack; without a source it gives no growth.
